passages.locator: IEEE Transactions on Electron Devices 18(11), p. 992, abstract, §II and author affiliation
passages.note: The Bell Labs team fabricated a 96-element, three-phase linear CCD. The authors were at Murray Hill.

Transfer was measured with a spot of light. The team mechanically scanned printed text and a photograph across the linear device to produce reconstructed images. A two-dimensional area device is described separately as a possible geometry.
